sentences.text: Victivallis vadensis is a strictly anaerobic, sugar-fermenting bacterium isolated from the human gastrointestinal tract, reported as the first cultured representative of the phylum Lentisphaerae.
A study of the same strain described it as a Gram-negative anaerobic bacterium isolated from a human fecal sample, and cloned a gene from its genome annotated as an agarase.
A metagenomic study of patients with disorders of gut-brain interaction reported Victivallis vadensis among subtype-specific microbial signatures, in the subtype abbreviated FC.
A Mendelian randomization study using MiBioGen consortium data reported the genus Victivallis as a risk factor among taxa causally linked to chronic rhinosinusitis.
